name: Nonda Mizuho
source:
The protagonist's mother in law. She is the mother of Mako and Miya. She is the current landlord of the inn.

She and her husband, Yoshikatsu, have not been spending much time together at night recently.

She is a little bit M-oriented, although she doesn't realize it. She sometimes gets pleasure from being exposed.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_006/chara_1.html]official site[/url]]
